title: Record the renewed c48_long compatibility receipt from the 2 November parity campaign
summary: The compatibility receipts in the repository bound source 717548d5, before the Ruff reformat, so only 11 of their 50 runtime files matched main and the loader would refuse the accepted controller on main. A campaign on 2 November 2026, run for PR 91 and left on Spark, had already renewed it: fresh standing admission at 1 and 128 robots, 13 of 13 learning probes through the native parity harness equal to the frozen ranges, a receipt binding 56 runtime files, and a CPU production-loader check. PR 91 merged on 4 November and all 56 bound files match main byte for byte. This record brings the receipt, ranges, summary, comparison, admission and campaign records into the repository and corrects the locomotion guide, which still called the certification pending. The native 13-probe replay through the production loader was not performed in that campaign.
next: Write configs/approved_code_version.json pointing at this receipt, and add the owner-file check to the site checker.
reason: Existing evidence is recorded and a guide sentence corrected. The checkpoint, runtime sources, the approved robot, acceptance gates and roadmap markers remain unchanged.
